name: Morph API
description: The Morph public API at api.morphllm.com: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible inference (chat completions, messages), Fast Apply code editing, Compact context compression, Reflex classification, Singleshot typed decisions, and fine-tuning. Model ids, prices, and context windows are served live at https://www.morphllm.com/api/models/json.
